PLAN 06 | SHOTS 14-17 | RESISTANCE IS BROKEN
Create a 15-second Seedance 2.5 cinematic sequence, horizontal 16:9. Exactly 4 shots with the local timing below. Preserve the assigned identities, masks, wardrobe, animal design and location geometry. Performance is expressed through posture, hands, breathing and weight. Render at natural speed with tactile analog texture.
CHARACTER REFERENCES
CHAR_SHAHRNAZ = {{CHAR_SHAHRNAZ}}
CHAR_ARNAVAZ = {{CHAR_ARNAVAZ}}
CHAR_GUARD_A = {{CHAR_GUARD_A}}
CHAR_GUARD_B = {{CHAR_GUARD_B}}
CHAR_GUARD_C = {{CHAR_GUARD_C}}
ANIMAL REFERENCES
ANIMAL_CAT = {{ANIMAL_CAT}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
LOC_TRANSFER_CORRIDOR = {{LOC_TRANSFER_CORRIDOR}}
START STATE AND BLOCKING
STATE_RESISTANCE_TO_INJURED. Continue the pivot: B holds Arnavaz’s right upper arm; C stands at her left rear. A and Shahrnaz wait one meter ahead. Shahrnaz cradles the cat. All characters are adults. Violence is brief, non-graphic and seen through bodies and cloth.

SHOT 14 | 00:00-00:04 | THE WALL
35mm side medium, camera at chest height. B redirects Arnavaz’s pivot; her left shoulder and upper back strike the wall. Her knees buckle and she slides onto her right hip. The camera dips with her fall, keeping her head clear of contact.
SHOT 15 | 00:04-00:07 | TWO IMPACTS
Cut to a 50mm low oblique view partly screened by B’s stationary leg. C delivers exactly two short kicks toward Arnavaz’s clothed outer thigh and flank. Her body folds protectively; the contact area is largely occluded. The two impacts occupy this brief shot only.
SHOT 16 | 00:07-00:10 | SHAHRNAZ WITNESSES
65mm close medium on Shahrnaz ahead. She turns toward Arnavaz; her forearms tighten around the supported cat, then her body freezes. A holds her upper sleeve. Keep the cat unharmed and breathing.
SHOT 17 | 00:10-00:15 | FORCED UPRIGHT
35mm same corridor side. B and C lift Arnavaz by her upper arms. Her feet search for purchase before she bears weight; her left shoulder remains low. They move her toward frame-right as A and Shahrnaz resume ahead. Cut on the first dragging step.
LIGHT AND IMAGE
One established corridor practical rakes the wall. Keep skin and clothing intact; reveal force through body displacement, breath and fabric compression.
SOUND
Shoulder-to-wall thud, cloth sliding down stone, two brief muffled impacts, Arnavaz’s expelled breath and boots resuming. Keep impact sound restrained and physical.
END STATE AND EDIT
B and C support Arnavaz upright by both upper arms; her left shoulder stays lowered and knees unsteady. Her left sleeve and skirt hem carry fresh stone dust. A resumes leading Shahrnaz toward the hall; the cat is alive and held securely.
Keep all character designs and prop ownership consistent across cuts. Use the camera paths stated for each shot and retain readable spatial relationships. Primitive ritual fashion cinema, analog realism. NO MUSIC, NO DIALOGUE.
